description: Binding append-only registry contract for approved Memory OS release baselines. Historical candidates, CI-compatible commits and branch heads are never release baselines by implication. A record exists only after named multi-role approval and immutable compatibility, recovery and artifact evidence are present. The writer verifies but never creates approvals, tags, evidence or production readiness.
requiredEvidenceClasses: current exact-source security and authorization evidence
parser artifact registry and retention evidence
load, capacity and operational alert evidence
known open risks with named owners and deadlines

eligibleRequires: binary starts against the expanded target schema
security, tenant, deletion and idempotency invariants remain valid
required parser artifacts and exact object versions remain retained
no destructive contract migration has removed required surfaces
rollback operation and recovery decision are reviewed

forbiddenRecordContent: account, session, job, preview or object identifiers
claims that candidate or local CI evidence is production evidence
registrationGuards: repository HEAD equals the requested commit SHA
working tree is clean and input record is outside the repository
release tag resolves to the exact requested commit
historical release commit SHAs must remain ancestors of the current repository HEAD
release ID and tag have never been registered
commit SHA has never been registered under another release
all evidence references are repository-relative existing files
all release evidence references resolve within the repository without symlink traversal
all release evidence references are tracked regular files whose current bytes exactly match the requested release commit
all required SHA-256 bindings are lowercase 64-character digests
approval roles are complete and assigned to distinct approver identifiers
record states evidenceComplete and productionReady true before registry mutation
registry update is protected by an exclusive filesystem lock and atomic replacement
registry is revalidated after append and restored byte-for-byte if post-append validation fails
registry change still requires validator execution and independent Git review

readiness.note: The writer exists but cannot manufacture approvals, evidence, a release tag or production readiness. No release is approved, so approved predecessor and rollback eligibility remain unavailable.
